featured_reviews.name: mukesh joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Tharu Sweets and had a wonderful experience.
The shop is clean, well-maintained, and welcoming.
I tried their famous Sindhi Dal Pakwan, and it was absolutely delicious.
The dal was flavorful and perfectly cooked.
The pakwan was crispy, fresh, and served hot.
The combination of dal and pakwan was simply outstanding.
The taste felt authentic and traditional.
Every bite reflected quality ingredients and careful preparation.
The portion size was generous and satisfying.
The staff members were polite and attentive.
Service was quick and efficient.
The atmosphere was comfortable and family-friendly.
The menu offers a good variety of sweets and snacks.
The freshness of the food was clearly noticeable.
The pricing is reasonable considering the quality served.
This is a great place for breakfast and evening snacks.
I would highly recommend their Sindhi Dal Pakwan to everyone.
It is one of the best Dal Pakwan experiences I have had.
The overall food quality and service exceeded my expectations.
I look forward to visiting Tharu Sweets again very soon. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.name: A B
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tharu Sweets in Bandra is a true gem! I cannot recommend them enough. The customer service I experienced was absolutely above and beyond my expectations. The staff genuinely care about their customers and go the extra mile to ensure a wonderful experience.
And the products? The quality is next to none. Every sweet I've tried has been incredibly fresh and delicious. Their gulab jamuns are heavenly—soft, juicy, and they just melt in your mouth. It's wonderful to see a business maintain such high standards for so long. I truly hope they are there for generations to enjoy. A must-visit if you're in the area!

Thank you once again 😊

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Trupti Achhipalia

featured_reviews.name: Masira Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best punjabi food in mumbai. They have wide range of menu. The prices are budget  friendly.
The ambience is lovely 🥰
I had ..
Chaas
Choley bhature
Samosa chole chaat
Rajma chaval
Dahi wada
And lastly Kesar Rabdi Kheer 😍
Everything was made fresh with proper hygiene.
The staff was very polite and the service was quick.
Everything was damn tasty i can vouch on the taste 👍🏻
but my personal favourite Kesar Rabdi Kheer and Rajma Chaval as it was served with a unique green chutney which made it taste even better😍
They have diffrent types of Combo’s as well such as Rajma Chawal, Choley Chawal etc.
Recently they had started serving diffrent types of chats as well such as dahi wada 😍 Samosa Choley Chat which was just outstanding.
I am definitely gonna visit this place soon, If you are Punjabi food lover dont miss out on this Place do visit it guys
Highly recommended ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

featured_reviews.name: Ketan Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: They offer a variety of sweets, farsan, and snacks with delicious flavors. I tried their Rasmalai, which was incredibly soft and perfectly sweet. In the evening, the shop tends to get quite crowded. It's a well-known shop in Andheri East.

featured_reviews.name: Sumit Lalwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place yesterday in the evening, was craving for choley bhature. It's located near evershine mall, Malad West.
The seating area is small and comfortable.

I ordered for Chholay bhature and kulcha which comes in whole wheat and maida. They serve three types of kulcha along with chholay. The taste was really authentic, i totally loved the way it was served Along with onion, pickle and green chutney.

Then I tried their Rajma chawal which was another fantastic dish, a complete comfort food, feels like homemade. The quality was amazing.

And finally the Chaas and Kesar Rabdi kheer which was so satisfying after this delicious meal.

Service was really good and the Staff Mr. Manish hosted us really good.
Must try out this place if you are around Evershine mall.

featured_reviews.name: Virendra Kumawat
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place just attracted to me by its name. I've been looking for chholay and kulche since long time and I saw this outlet so decided to visit.

I tried, Kulche and chholay it was really good and delicious in taste. It had achar, onions and chutney in it served along with butter milk. The speciality is this place serve in leaf plate which i really loved.

The rajma chawal and jeera was also amazing. 😍😍

The Kesar rabdi kheer was really good. The taste and the quality was on point. The perfect indian dessert.

The service was amazing and taste was on point.
Really worth visiting this place.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently ordered some items from this amazing place which serves huge variety of sweets, farsans, chats, samosa, gulab jamuns etc.

The hamper consisted of:
Gulam Jamun tub of 6 pc
Kesar Pista Shrikhand 250 gm Khaman Dhokla 100 gm

Kachori
Kaju Dalmoth

The packaging was good and spill proof.

Also the quality of the food is too good.

The food items here are fresh and yumm.

The samosa I had was unique as it had Cashew nuts, Kishmish etc in its stuffing.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Rajiwade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sangeeta...!

They are serving since more than 50 years and you will feel the authenticity of there experience in the food.

They are taking care of all the necessary action while preparing and packaging of food & Snacks.

They have wide range of mithai, Snacks, Farsan. You name it they have it. They are preparing everything fresh on daily basis and you will get the options like sugar free mithai and all over there.

I have tried there following options

1. Samosa & Kachori - It is full of Flavours and it's fresh. It is filled with dry fruits and love it.

2. Moongdal Kachori - This is having perfect texture and the filling is proper and it's very affordable.

3. Kaju Dalmoth - This is something new which I tried and it is perfect chakna item I must say. It is having flavoured kAju and fried masoor daal which is perfect combination.

4. Milk Cake - Perfect amount of sweetness and it's fresh. Love it.

5. Mango Burfi - The flavours of mango is so good and it is made freshly so I love it absolutely.

6. Kesar Shrikhand - This is the best Shrikhand I tried till date. It is so good you have to try it.

Overall it's a perfect shop where you will buy all the munchies, snacks and mithai. Trust me they will serve you best.

Overall ratings

Food - 5/5
Packaging- 5/5
Value for money - 5/5

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great place for amazing sweets and savouries. Absolutely delicious and fresh sweets available at the outlet. Good packaging and quality of the food. Great place to enjoy some quick snacks and healthy options as well.
• Kaju Katli:- Kaju katli always everyone's favourite. Absolutely delicious and fresh. The kaju katli had a rich cashew taste and would definitely recommend this.
• Mango Burfi:- Soft mango barfi, with the perfect balanced sweetness. Absolutely great and delicious.
• Yellow Dhokla:- Soft, juicy dhoklas served along with some green chutney. Absolutely amazing.
• Kachori:- 2 big size kachori with generous amount of fillings. Truly delicious and a great quick snacks.
• Corn Flakes Chivda:- An amazing packed snack and deliciously fresh. Great packaging as well easy to store.
• Kaju Dalmoth:- A delicious crunchy delight. Absolutely delicious and super yum.

featured_reviews.name: Indica Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Few days ago, I ordered some yummy sweets and also snacks from Eastern Sweets by Sangeeta .They have variety of sweets and good quality of all .
I tried mango barfi and malai peda which was absolutely yummy and I couldn't stop enjoying . Top notch quality .Rest we tried their dhokla and kaju dalmooth and moongdal kachori .
Their taste ,quality everything is great and even packaging has indianised touch to it.Would surely love to try again.

featured_reviews.name: Jatin Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sangeeta has been a household name for many over decades. It's been around for more than 50 years now serving delicious Mithai, Farsan, Snacks, Dry Fruits, Namkeens, Confectionery, etc. Recently they have also started a range of Sugarless Mithais taking into consideration the health factor and also catering to younger demographics now.

Recently stepped into Eastern Sweets by Sangeeta outlet at Peddar Road, it's been renovated now and gives a nice contemporary look. I have always been a fan of Sangeeta's Kesari Shrikhand and Punjabi Samosas. We keep ordering on a regular basis. Besides these, this time around I also ordered Yellow Dhokla (Khaman), Moongdal Kachori, Cornflakes Chivda and Malai Peda. The quality at Sangeeta as usual was top notch. Simply loved the taste!

featured_reviews.name: Vedant Pitnaik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered up mithais and some snacks from here a few days back. Came well packed and the quality of each and every item was just amazing 🔥. Each and every item looked super presentable too. Pricing of the items were moderate.
.
I ordered the following sweets and snacks :-
.
1. KACHORI :- was fresh. Had good amount of masala filling inside. Tasted great as it is.
.
2. MANGO BARFI :- the best barfi ! A mjst try for sure.  Ordered 150 gm of these which had 4 portions.  Had  real mava with a subtle flavor of mango, not too overpowering. Loved it a lot. RECOMMENDED 🏁
.
3. CRANBERRY SUGAR-FREE BITE:- anothe one of the unique mithai. It was loaded with dryfruits and cranberries too. Had almonds, cranberries and pistachios . Moreover being sugar-free was a bonus. Taste was great. RECOMMENDED 🏁
.
4. KAJU DALMOOTH :- perfect snack for evenings. Had whole masoor daal with sev and kaju. Seasoned and flavored perfectly. Loved it !

featured_reviews.name: Siddhi Parekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Are you cravings for a place where you get snacks, sweets, farsan and everything?!
Sangeeta eastern enterprise is the best place for it.. It is located at pedder road just 2 minutes form Mahalaxmi temple.
I tried many items from there like:

Samosa: very crispy cover and the stuffing was also as it should be little spicy but yummy too!!
Khaman dhokla: nice spongy with tadka on top served with yummy green chutney!!
Mango barfi l: unlike the other mango barfi I have tried they are little hard to bite but this was the be one, extra soft and just melting in mouth!!
Farali chivda: it is the best for the people who fast and can be a good filling for them as it consist of lots of dry fruits too like cashews, badam!!
Kaju dalmooth: best to just munch in snacks with dal sev and cashews!!
And last but my FAVOURITE 😍
Gulab jamun: Perfect as it should be..cooked properly till inside and nicely set in the sugar syrup!!
